resources.string: No associated subscription; no candidate checked
Candidate check failed. Review resource contents and references.
Inspect stable-ID relationships between subscriptions, local scripts or configurations, strategy groups, rule sets and chain groups.

Open relationships from a resource card or editor to inspect its users, dependencies and affected subscriptions. Tap an entry to follow a link. Disabled references remain marked and indirect references count toward associations.

Scripts and configurations are mutually exclusive. Configurations order strategy groups, which reference rule sets; chain bindings are independent. Disabling routing or a group retains references. A rule set has one owning group. Text in scripts or notes does not create links. Repair missing references; running sessions require a restart.
Check the draft structure, the complete resource graph and composed candidates for every associated subscription, then run static checks with the bundled mihomo core.

Review affected subscriptions and their results before saving; open YAML for passing candidates. A script or configuration can also be tested with an additional subscription. Groups and rule sets use their existing configuration links. Chain node and source drafts can also be checked.

Preview does not save resources or bindings or start VPN. Without an associated subscription, only resources and references are checked. Previewing a new URL explicitly downloads it without committing. Saving checks again and retains old data and drafts on failure. Static checks do not prove connectivity. YAML may contain credentials; review before exporting.
